name: chunk_needles
description: Scan a local file (or icat an inode from the E01) for ASCII/UTF-16 needles; return hit counts and nearby snippets

needles.description: Pipe-separated strings to search (ASCII and UTF-16LE)

inode.description: If set, icat this inode from the E01

image.description: Image for inode extraction. Defaults to the single image under inputs/.

offset.description: Optional volume offset in sectors for icat -o
